# Inside Precision Medicine

> Inside Precision Medicine covers the latest advances in precision diagnostics, liquid biopsy technologies, genomic analysis, and personalized medicine with focus on clinical applications and regulatory developments.

The site publishes news, features, and analysis on precision medicine innovations including NGS-based diagnostics, biomarker discovery, cancer screening technologies, and FDA regulatory policy affecting laboratory-developed tests and in vitro diagnostics.

## Key Topics

- Liquid Biopsy
- ctDNA (Circulating Tumor DNA)
- NGS (Next-Generation Sequencing)
- ddPCR (Digital Droplet PCR)
- Laboratory-Developed Tests (LDT)
- Biomarkers
- Cancer Diagnostics
- Genomic Analysis
- Exosomes
- Circulating Tumor Cells (CTC)
- FDA Regulation
- Molecular Diagnostics
- Pharmacogenomics
- In Vitro Diagnostics (IVD)
- Precision Medicine

## Cancer Diagnostics & Biomarkers

- [New Liquid Biopsy Test Uses Platelet RNA as Cancer Diagnostic](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/new-liquid-biopsy-test-uses-platelet-rna-as-cancer-diagnostic): Liquid biopsy using platelet RNA for cancer screening with NGS technology
- [Tumor Microenvironment Diversity Predicts Breast Cancer Outcomes](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/tumor-microenvironment-diversity-predicts-breast-cancer-outcomes): Breast cancer outcome prediction using tumor microenvironment and genomic data
- [Early Pancreatic Cancer Biomarkers Uncovered](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/early-pancreatic-cancer-biomarkers-uncovered): Pancreatic cancer early detection biomarkers and gene classifier discovery
- [Big Data Screen Uncovers New Cancer Driver Genes](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/big-data-screen-uncovers-new-cancer-driver-genes): Big data analysis identifies cancer driver genes and protein structure drug targets
- [Finer Cancer Screens Catch More Cancer Clues](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/finer-cancer-screens-catch-more-cancer-clues): Advances in genomic analysis for breast cancer screening and somatic mutations
- [Biocept to Study CTC Diagnostics Platform for Immunotherapy Targets](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/biocept-to-study-ctc-diagnostics-platform-for-immunotherapy-targets): CTC liquid biopsy study for PD-L1 detection in bladder and prostate cancer
- [Illumina, Merck Serono to Partner on NGS-Based Cancer Diagnostics](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/illumina-merck-serono-to-partner-on-ngs-based-cancer-diagnostics): Partnership on NGS-based cancer diagnostics for oncology clinical trials

## Regulatory & Laboratory Testing

- [FDA Regulation of LDTs Gets Contentious](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/fda-regulation-of-ldts-gets-contentious): FDA regulatory policy debate on laboratory-developed tests oversight
- [Snapshot: LDT Labs Prepare for the Eventuality of FDA Oversight](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/snapshot-ldt-labs-prepare-for-the-eventuality-of-fda-oversight): Analysis of FDA regulatory oversight implications for laboratory-developed tests
- [Defining a Molecular Dx Curriculum for Clinical Lab Scientists](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/defining-a-molecular-dx-curriculum-for-clinical-lab-scientists): Molecular diagnostics curriculum development for clinical laboratory scientists

## Liquid Biopsy & Advanced Technologies

- [Liquid Biopsy and ddPCR: A Match with Quality in Mind](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/liquid-biopsy-and-ddpcr-a-match-with-quality-in-mind): Webinar on liquid biopsy and ddPCR technology for ctDNA quality assessment
- [Harnessing the Power of Exosomes](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/harnessing-the-power-of-exosomes): Exosomes and nanovesicles as biomarkers for drug delivery and diagnostics

## Precision Medicine Applications

- [Pharmacogenomics Makes the Heart Grow Stronger](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/pharmacogenomics-makes-the-heart-grow-stronger): Pharmacogenomics and genetic variation in cardiovascular disease drug response
- [Genetic Variance Found as Cause for Cerebral Palsy](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/genetic-variance-found-as-cause-for-cerebral-palsy): Genetic variance discovery in cerebral palsy pediatric neurology research
- [Affymetrix, Cytox to Co-Develop Alzheimer's Assay](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/affymetrix-cytox-to-co-develop-alzheimers-assay): Partnership announcement for Alzheimer's disease blood-based genetic biomarker assay
- [Transgenomic Licenses Genetic Cardiac Test to LabCorp](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/transgenomic-licenses-genetic-cardiac-test-to-labcorp): Licensing agreement for long QT syndrome genetic cardiac DNA testing

- [Cancer Genetics Buys Gentris for Up to $6.25M](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/cancer-genetics-buys-gentris-for-up-to-6-25m): M&A announcement: Cancer Genetics acquisition of Gentris for genomic profiling
- [Cliniqa Now Owned by Bio-Techne](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/cliniqa-now-owned-by-bio-techne): Acquisition of Cliniqa by Bio-Techne for clinical diagnostics and IVD market
- [This Is Not Your Grandmother's Med School's Genetics Course](https://www.insideprecisionmedicine.com/news-and-features/this-is-not-your-grandmothers-med-schools-genetics-course): Modern genetics curriculum and precision medicine education at medical schools
